steps.mechanism: CORANK RECURSION: the two-matrix SchurCore Δ·S object (Δ square r×r, S free r×p), WellFounded on the corank r of the single square factor via SchurRecStep; exponent-shift c''=c'−jp/2. Closes the box at L=2 (prod = A0·A1 IS SchurCore) for ALL (r,r,p).
steps.why_changed: Intrinsically two-matrix with NO layer index — p is a fixed spectator, the measure is corank. For L≥3 the integrand is an L-fold product, not frobSq(Δ·S) for any free (Δ,S) box-equivalent, and the target ½·minAdm is a SUM over a multi-boundary rank path (≥2 active boundaries in 86/256 L=3 chains). r1upper-derisk / wall-review corroborated the WALL with exact algebra (minAdm re-derived, 0/3000 mismatches) and a factor-of-2 counterexample at (3,3,3,3).

steps.mechanism: FRONT-PEEL ARITY RECURSION: peel the outer layer with fibre_lintegral_mul_le (∫ frobSq(X·Y)^{-c'} ≤ C·frobSq(Y)^{-c'}, cap c'<p/2 the peeled row count), recurse on the tail, stop at any length-2 suffix via the closed SchurCore reach; allow either-end peel by transpose symmetry.
steps.why_changed: Exponent-PRESERVING: it caps the total at the single most-binding layer (min over boundaries), not the sum. Closes 231/320 chains but UNDERSHOOTS ½·minAdm by exactly a factor of 2 at (3,3,3,3) (needs c'<3, best peel reaches c'<3/2). No repo mechanism converts budget spent at one boundary into a reduced exponent on the residual. The additive staircase [1,2,3] no exponent-preserving two-matrix step reaches.

CONSUME for the top strata (B3/B4); do NOT consume on the ~86% deeper strata.
